items.title: Charlie Bocage Interview, 1960-07-18
items.q: And then me and my daddy and my other brother, Henry. We used to play a little violin too. We had a little three piece band

ctx.x: Did you play any guitar or banjo at that time? No. Never had a lesson on anything?

I used to play guitar. You know, just by head like that. When I was a young kid. Sing and play. Just for past time. And then me and my daddy and my other brother, Henry. We used to play a little violin too. We had a little three piece band, you know. Played a lot of house poetry and things. And then I was always musical, you see. And then after I got married, Pete enticed me to take up the banjo, you see. Which I did. Made a start of the banjo and I... Went pretty good ways on the banjo. I don't say I was a great…
This is the one you used to sing on?
